actions: Server receives POST /message:send with A2A-Version header value 0.5
Server determines requested version 0.5 is not in its supported versions list
Server returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with Content-Type: application/problem+json
Response body includes type, title, status, detail, and supportedVersions fields

statements.subject: task
statements.description: "state": "submitted" — task status state returned in the server response immediately after a push-notification-enabled task is submitted via message:send

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Client sends POST /message:send with configuration.pushNotificationConfig; server responds HTTP 200 with task object whose status.state is 'submitted'
actions: Server receives POST /message:send with pushNotificationConfig in configuration
Server registers pushNotificationConfig.url and pushNotificationConfig.token for the new task
Server responds HTTP 200 with task object containing id, contextId, and status.state = submitted

statements.subject: client
statements.description: All JSON-RPC requests MUST follow the standard JSON-RPC 2.0 format:
statements.post_cond: request.jsonrpc = "2.0" & request.id != null & request.method != null & request.params != null
actions: Set jsonrpc field to '2.0'
Include a unique request id field
Include a method field in 'category/action' format
Include a params field with method-specific parameters

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Sends a message to initiate or continue a task.
actions: client sends SendMessageRequest to server
server processes message and returns SendMessageResponse containing either a Task or Message object

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A2A service parameters defined in Section 3.2.6 MUST be transmitted using gRPC metadata (headers).
actions: Encode all A2A service parameters as gRPC metadata (headers) in the outgoing request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Service parameter names MUST be transmitted as gRPC metadata keys
actions: Map each A2A service parameter name to a gRPC metadata key in the outgoing request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Multiple values for the same service parameter (e.g., A2A-Extensions) SHOULD be comma-separated in a single metadata entry
actions: Concatenate multiple values for the same service parameter into a single comma-separated metadata entry

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Note: A SendMessageResponse MUST contain exactly one of the following: task, message
statements.post_cond: (response.task != null & response.message = null) | (response.task = null & response.message != null)
actions: Include exactly one of the task or message fields in the SendMessageResponse — never both, never neither

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: REST streaming uses Server-Sent Events with the data field containing JSON serializations of the protocol data objects: POST /message:stream
actions: Client sends POST /message:stream with Content-Type: application/json and SendMessageRequest body
Server responds HTTP 200 OK with Content-Type: text/event-stream
Server sends first SSE event containing Task or single Message

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The value MUST be in the format Major.Minor (e.g., "0.3").
actions: Format the A2A-Version header value as Major.Minor (e.g., "0.3")

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the version is not supported by the agent, the agent returns a VersionNotSupportedError.
actions: agent returns VersionNotSupportedError

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: When serialized to JSON (in JSON-RPC, HTTP/REST, or other JSON-based bindings), these timestamps MUST be represented as ISO 8601 formatted strings in UTC timezone.
actions: Represent timestamps as ISO 8601 formatted strings in UTC timezone

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When millisecond precision is not available, the fractional seconds portion MAY be omitted or zero-filled
actions: Omit or zero-fill the fractional seconds portion of the timestamp

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Implementations SHOULD validate these requirements and reject messages with missing required fields.
actions: Validate that all required fields are present in the received message
Reject messages that have missing required fields

statements.subject: extension
statements.description: Custom bindings MUST provide clear mappings for: Protocol Buffer Types: Define how each Protocol Buffer message type is represented; Timestamps: Follow the conventions in Section 5.6.1 (Timestamps); Binary Data: Specify encoding for binary content (e.g., base64 for text-based protocols); Enumerations: Define representation of enum values (e.g., strings, integers)
actions: Define how each Protocol Buffer message type is represented
Follow timestamp conventions from Section 5.6.1
Specify encoding for binary content
Define representation of enum values

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Requests the cancellation of an ongoing task. The server will attempt to cancel the task, but success is not guaranteed (e.g., the task might have already completed or failed, or cancellation might not be supported at its current stage). The operation attempts to cancel the specified task and returns its updated state.
statements.post_cond: task.state = TASK_STATE_CANCELED (if successful); task.state unchanged or terminal (if cancellation fails)
actions: cancellation attempted on specified task
updated task state returned to client

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents can request additional input mid-processing by transitioning a task to the input-required state

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Agents can request additional input mid-processing by transitioning a task to the input-required state
actions: Agent transitions task to input-required state
Agent signals to client that additional input is required

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Indicates that the agent requires additional user input to proceed. This is an interrupted state.

statements.subject: task
statements.description: A2A provides the capability for agents to delegate the fulfillment of this authorization to the client via the TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED Task state. This provides agents a fallback path for requesting authorization by passing the responsibility to the client.

statements.subject: task
statements.description: To request that a client fulfills an authorization request, the agent MUST transition the TaskState to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
actions: Agent transitions TaskState to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
Agent includes a TaskStatus message explaining the required authorization

statements.subject: agent
statements.description: MUST transition the TaskState to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
actions: Transition the TaskState to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED

statements.subject: server
statements.description: MUST include a TaskStatus message explaining the required authorization, unless the details of the authorization have been negotiated out-of-band or via an extension
actions: Include a TaskStatus message that explains the required authorization

statements.subject: agent
statements.description: Agents MUST arrange to receive credentials via an out-of-band means, unless an in-band mechanism has been negotiated out-of-band or via an extension.
actions: Arrange to receive credentials via an out-of-band means

statements.subject: agent
statements.description: If the credential is received out-of-band, the agent SHOULD maintain any active response streams with the client after setting the TaskState to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED.
actions: Maintain any active response streams with the client after setting the TaskState to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The agent MAY immediately continue Task processing after receiving the credential, without a requirement that clients send a follow-up message.
actions: Immediately continue Task processing after receiving the credential without waiting for a client follow-up message

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Agents SHOULD support receiving messages directed to the Task while the Task remains in TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED.
actions: Accept and process messages directed to the Task while Task remains in TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED

statements.subject: task
statements.description: If the client is itself an A2A agent actively processing a Task, the client may further delegate the authorization request to its client by transitioning its own Task to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED.
statements.pre_cond: client.is_a2a_agent = true & client.is_actively_processing_task = true & received_task.state = TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
actions: Client transitions its own Task to TASK_STATE_AUTH_REQUIRED
Client SHOULD follow all In-Task Authorization Agent Responsibilities

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client SHOULD follow all In-Task Authorization Agent Responsibilities.
statements.pre_cond: client.is_a2a_agent = true & client.task is actively being processed
actions: Follow all In-Task Authorization Agent Responsibilities when delegating the authorization request to the client's own client

statements.subject: client
statements.description: To avoid this, a client SHOULD perform one of the following: Subscribe to a stream of events for the Task using the Subscribe to Task operation / Register a webhook to receive events, if supported by the agent, using the Create Push Notification Config operation / Begin polling the Task using the Get Task operation
actions: Subscribe to a stream of events for the Task using the Subscribe to Task operation, OR
Register a webhook to receive events using the Create Push Notification Config operation, OR
Begin polling the Task using the Get Task operation

statements.subject: task
statements.description: Cancels an ongoing task.
statements.pre_cond: !(task.state = TASK_STATE_COMPLETED | task.state = TASK_STATE_FAILED | task.state = TASK_STATE_CANCELED | task.state = TASK_STATE_REJECTED)
actions: client sends CancelTask request with task id
server cancels the ongoing task

statements.subject: task
statements.description: CancelTask: Cancels a task in progress.
statements.pre_cond: !(task.state = completed | task.state = failed | task.state = canceled | task.state = rejected)
actions: Server cancels the task currently in progress
Server returns updated Task object reflecting canceled state

statements.subject: streaming
statements.description: until the task reaches a terminal or interrupted state, at which point the stream closes. Implementations SHOULD avoid re-ordering events and MAY optionally resend a final Task snapshot before closing.
actions: Server optionally resends final Task snapshot before closing
Server closes SSE stream
